# PanoPublish — Comprehensive System Architecture, Product Context & SEO Documentation

> **Document Type**: Full Technical & Product Context for LLMs (Large Language Models) and Generative Search Engines  
> **Canonical Domain**: https://panopublish.com/  
> **Primary Audience**: Photographers, agencies, and businesses  

---

## 1. Product Context & Core Functionality

### What is PanoPublish?
PanoPublish is a 360° virtual tour and Google Street View publishing platform for photographers, agencies, and businesses. Create, manage, brand, host, and publish immersive 360° tours to Google Maps and Street View with professional project management and INR pricing.

### Primary Problem Solved
- **High Forex Fees & USD Pricing**: Global virtual tour platforms (Matterport, CloudPano, GoThru) bill in US Dollars (USD), forcing Indian photographers and agencies to pay credit card international transaction surcharges (3.5%+) and unpredictable exchange rates. PanoPublish provides flat INR pricing (₹499/mo Basic, ₹1,499/mo Pro, ₹2,999/mo Agency) with native Razorpay UPI payments.
- **Expensive Per-Export Fees**: Matterport charges $14.99 per Google Street View export. PanoPublish includes unlimited Street View publishing.
- **Manual Tripod Removal**: PanoPublish features an automated Nadir logo editor that overlays circular custom branding disks to obscure tripods without requiring Photoshop.
- **Google Maps Blue-Line Connections**: Photographers can set compass headings, spatial node connections, and publish multi-photo blue-line walk-throughs to Google Maps via the official Google Street View Publish API.

---

## 2. Technical Architecture & Build Configuration

### Tech Stack Details
- **Frontend Framework**: React 19 + TypeScript
- **Router**: TanStack Router (`@tanstack/react-router`) with file-based routing in `src/routes/`
- **State & Data Management**: TanStack Query (`@tanstack/react-query`)
- **SSR / SSG**: TanStack Start (`@tanstack/react-start`) + Vite build (`@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config`)
- **Hosting Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers Edge Runtime (`nodejs_compat`)
- **Databases**:
  - **Cloudflare D1**: SQLite edge database storing profiles, clients, tours, islands/floors, photo metadata, connections, subscriptions, and SEO tables.
  - **Supabase**: Postgres database, User Authentication, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 (`panopublish-photos`) for zero-egress equirectangular panorama storage.
- **Image & 360 Engines**: Marzipano & Pannellum (WebGL panorama renderers), Jimp (image composition), JSZip (client zip generator), Exifr (EXIF GPS & heading metadata reader).
- **Payment Gateway**: Razorpay (UPI, NetBanking, Cards).

### Pre-rendering & Build Scripts
- `generate-sitemap.cjs`: Pre-build script that compiles `public/sitemap.xml` covering 183+ static routes with custom priority indices.
- `prerender-routes.cjs`: Post-build script that executes SSR requests against `dist/server/index.js` for all public pages, producing fully hydrated static HTML files in `dist/client/` for maximum search engine crawlability.

---

## 3. Current SEO Strategy & Implementation

### 1. 100% Static HTML Prerendering (SSG/SSR Hybrid)
Every public route (homepage, pricing, service hubs, city pages, comparison landing pages, blog articles) is pre-rendered into static HTML (`dist/client/`). Search bots (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, PerplexityBot) load full content DOM instantly without client-side rendering delays.

### 2. Rich Schema.org / JSON-LD Structured Data
- `SoftwareApplication`: Injected on landing pages with SaaS details, pricing in INR, and feature list.
- `Organization` & `LocalBusiness`: Declares company identity, logo, social links, and geographic targeting (India).
- `FAQPage`: Injected on FAQ and service pages for interactive Google Search snippet accordions.
- `Article` & `Person`: Injected on `/blog/*` and `/authors/*` to establish Google EEAT credentials for author Prashant Kumar (Google Street View Trusted Photographer).
- `BreadcrumbList`: Injected across all child routes for visual search result taxonomies.

### 3. Programmatic Content & Topic Clusters
The platform includes 4 dedicated topic clusters (defined in `src/lib/`):
- **Cluster 1: Virtual Tour Software** (25 guides on 360 tour software, Nadir branding, WebGL viewable tours, alternatives to Matterport/CloudPano/GoThru).
- **Cluster 2: Google Street View** (25 guides on Google Maps publishing, blue-line connections, Street View trusted program).
- **Cluster 3: 360 Photography** (25 guides on 360 cameras like Ricoh Theta Z1, Insta360 X4, GoPro MAX, and PTGui stitching workflows).
- **Cluster 4: Industry Solutions** (25 vertical landing pages for Hotels, Real Estate, Corporate Offices, Universities, Restaurants, Gyms).
- **Regional City Hubs**: 10 targeted Indian city pages (Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Jaipur, Surat).

### 4. Search Engine & LLM Crawlability
- `robots.txt`: Grants full crawling access to search engines and AI agents (`GPTBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`).
- `sitemap.xml`: Updated dynamically on every compilation.
- `llms.txt` & `llms-full.txt`: Standardized AI context guides for LLM ingestion.
